name: Xiaomi TV Box S (3rd gen)
summary: Clean up the Xiaomi TV Box S 3rd gen: switch off Xiaomi tracking, PatchWall promo rows and preloaded apps with a free phone app, a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: The Xiaomi TV Box S (3rd gen) ships with Xiaomi analytics and a quality-stats uploader. It also has PatchWall content rows, promos and auto-installs, plus preloaded apps such as Disney+, HBO Max, YouTube Music, Play Games, a Mi video player and a gallery.

This list was tested for one evening on Google TV 14, covering the home screen, the app grid, the D-pad and a reboot. It has not been lived with for days yet. The voice assistant and the remote service stay on so the remote's mic works. TidyTV turns the apps off over Wi-Fi with a backup first and deletes nothing.
keep: Google Assistant, so the remote's mic button works
The Google TV remote service, which the mic also needs
Xiaomi setup partner and TV services (mitv.service)
Mi cast and share, phone remote, and the Play Store
notes: The mic needs both the assistant and the remote service. Turning off only one of them leaves the button recording silence, so both are kept on.
The setup wizard takes over Home once the stock home is off, so it has to be turned off first. Re-enable it to pair a new remote.
The Wi-Fi network saved during first setup belongs to the setup wizard. Join it again by hand in Settings first, or turning the wizard off can drop Wi-Fi.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Xiaomi box?
faq.a: Yes. The voice assistant and the remote service both stay on, because the remote's mic needs both of them.

faq.q: Will it remove the PatchWall rows and promos?
faq.a: Yes. PatchWall, its content rows, promos and the auto-install setup are turned off. The apps are only switched off, not uninstalled.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
